eyebrow.zh: 跑偏了别重启 · 改记忆 · 看决策 diff
eyebrow.en: Don't restart · Patch memory · See the diff

headline.zh:
给跑偏的 coding agent
打个记忆补丁
headline.en:
Patch a derailed agent's
memory, see the diff

sub.zh: 在决策树里找到锚点,写一段修正;before/after 决策 diff 机械可核验,不是模型讲故事。
sub.en: Find an anchor in the decision tree, write a correction; the before/after decision diff is mechanical and checkable, never a model's story.

title.zh: 看见 agent 此刻记着什么
title.en: See what the agent remembers right now

body.zh: 一条命令把整条会话渲染成决策树加当前工作记忆——agent 在哪个分叉做了什么、此刻脑子里装着什么,一眼看清,只读无副作用。
body.en: One command renders the whole session as a decision tree plus the current working memory — where the agent branched and what it holds in its head right now, all in view. Read-only, no side effects.

title.zh: 在任一锚点写一段修正
title.en: Write a correction at any anchor

body.zh: 打开编辑器,在决策树任一锚点插入一段修正的 plan;锚点写入前先核验,补丁文件随你带走,不绑死在一台机器上。
body.en: Open your editor, insert a corrected plan at any anchor in the decision tree; the anchor is verified before it lands, and the patch file travels with you instead of being locked to one machine.

title.zh: 决策 diff 是机械对齐,不是模型讲故事
title.en: The decision diff is mechanical, not a model's story

body.zh: before/after 的 agent 决策逐条对齐,只报真正变了的那些,绝不编一句“因为你的补丁所以改变”;测试守住这条底线,谁也别让它退化成黑箱归因。
body.en: Before/after agent decisions are paired one-to-one; only what truly changed gets reported, and no ‘this changed because of your patch’ narrative is ever invented. Tests hold this line so it never collapses into black-box attribution.

title.zh: 本地跑 · 你的会话不出机器
title.en: Runs locally · your sessions never leave the machine

body.zh: 读你自己机器上的会话文件,不上云、不注册账号、不外发。MIT 开源,装上即用,跑偏的长 run 不必再赌一把重启。
body.en: Reads the session files already on your own machine — no cloud, no account, nothing sent out. MIT open source; install and go, and a derailed long run no longer means gambling on a restart.

headline.zh: 跑偏了别重启,打个补丁

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、本地跑。看见 agent 的记忆,在锚点写一段修正,decision diff 机械可核验。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, runs locally. See the agent's memory, write a correction at an anchor, and a mechanical, checkable decision diff.

tag.zh: MIT · 本地优先 · 给 coding agent 的记忆补丁,不是重启
tag.en: MIT · local-first · a memory patch for coding agents, not a restart
